def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    n = len(state[0])
    next_state = []
    for i in range(n):
        # Compute range-hexad (indices -3,-2,-1,+1,+2,+3 mod n)
        hexad = [
            state[0][(i-3)%n],
            state[0][(i-2)%n],
            state[0][(i-1)%n],
            state[0][(i+1)%n],
            state[0][(i+2)%n],
            state[0][(i+3)%n]
        ]
        s = sum(hexad) % 3
        ck = hexad.count(0)
        cs = hexad.count(1)
        cd = hexad.count(2)
        # Formula based on pattern analysis
        # next = (s * state + ck + cs) % 3
        # Note: This may not be perfect for all cases
        next_val = (s * state[0][i] + ck + cs) % 3
        next_state.append(next_val)
    return [next_state]
